Successor to the pre-issuance art-06 attestation pre-check; not a substitute for it. The OCC issued its final implementing rule on 2026-10-21 (Bulletin 2026-50, 12 CFR Part 15, effective 2027-01-18), so the 120-day leg falls after the statutory 18-month date and applicable_deadline 2027-01-18 (the 18-month leg of the GENIUS Act, Pub. L. 119-27 (S.1582) §20 effective date) stands; final rules of the other primary Federal payment stablecoin regulators were not checked.
